purpose: Third-party ICC profiles (Windows/Adobe, never committed) that oracle_t1_lcms2 and wide_profiles compare against. Tests read them ONLY from this external root (and the override env var), never from system directories.
icc_root_relative_to: the crate directory (CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR = <worktree>/handshake-studio-assets/crates/hsk-studio-prism); resolves to the Handshake_Artifacts sibling of the worktrees on the same disk
override_env_meaning: optional OS path list searched before icc_root
missing_profile: the case prints `NOT_PROVEN: <test> <case> reason=<installed_profile_absent|profile_sha256_mismatch> ...` and returns without a verdict; with require_corpus true or env HSK_PRISM_REQUIRE_CORPUS=1 it fails instead
populate: python tests/oracle/populate_corpus.py [--from DIR]... (stdlib only; READS the system profile directories named in t1_lcms2.json default_locations, copies only SHA-256-verified files into icc_root, writes icc_root/MANIFEST.json; never builds or tests)
files: t1_lcms2.json profiles with origin=installed (name + SHA-256 recorded there)
